why: Fix round of the tests step of slice E47 of the Effect-checker sweep (ticket 1075), in our tooling and next/ exam paths: globalConsole and globalConsoleInEffect. Two changes. First, an owner ruling made this round: tooling imports Effect by subpath (effect/Console, effect/Effect and so on), not from the effect barrel, which costs about 250 ms per script start. It overrides the plan's call 2 (barrel form). effect 4.1.3's package.json maps ./* to ./dist/*.js, so each module is its own subpath. The 13 files the first tests round touched that import effect now import each name as a namespace from its module, with a type import kept as a type import (time-table.ts's Duration): field-check.ts, legs.ts, shard-rows.ts, shard-times.ts, time-table.ts, workflow-lint.ts, promise-types.ts, instance-one-file.integration.test.ts, worker-mail.integration.test.ts, exact-versions.ts, lint.ts, one-machine-per-file.test.ts, stylelint.ts and workspace-reach.ts. Fixture source inside template strings was left as it is. No try/catch fallout: fabrika/no-raw-try-catch fires on a subpath import as on the barrel, and the earlier Effect.try fixes stand. Second, the review's bug: lintWorkflow in .github/ci/workflow-lint.ts checked only parseDocument's errors and then called toJS outside any catch, so a text whose aliases expand past yaml's limit threw ReferenceError where main answered check.yaml: invalid YAML. It now parses with Result.try(() => parse(text)) and answers invalid YAML on any failure, as main's try did. A new property law holds it. Hits: 99 met, 92 fixed by hand edits in earlier rounds, 0 by quick fix, 7 left for an owner call and not touched this round (changes.mjs 1, required.mjs 2, scheduled.mjs 2, gitignore.mjs 1, program-package-layout.test.ts 1), 0 waiting on 1366. This round changed only import lines and the one parse, so the count is unchanged.
